I turned on data labels for the OperatingHours series in the HoursBySite chart, and they only display where the site's total is 100 or more hours.

The label visibility is set to `=IIf(Sum(Fields!OperatingHours.Value) >= 100, true, false)`. The threshold is checked against each column's summed hours, so a site at 99.5 hours gets no label and one at 100 gets a label. I did not render the report, so I haven't seen the labels appear in the preview.

The validator reports no errors. Its warnings were already there and don't relate to this change: two unused data sources, two date-like parameters typed as String, and an orphan `Utilization` field in DataSet1.
